'''Krayt-leather''' was a type of [[Leather/Legends|leather]] used in upholstery. [[Aryn Dro Thul]] of [[Bornaryn Trading]] had krayt-leather couches aboard the ''[[Tradewyn]]'', the company's mighty [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
